_: Shared copy and structure for the public marketing pages (product-*.html, later pricing.html). Read by scripts/make-marketing-pages.mjs, which writes the committed HTML. The per-page copy lives in marketing-pages.json. Nothing here names the product: the generator stamps {{brand:...}}. A stage's hue class is an EXISTING one from tokens.css (.hue-library, .hue-feature, .hue-plan, .hue-shoot).

writing.blurb: Write in a screenplay editor that sets the format as you type.

story.blurb: Lay your beats out on a board and see the shape of the story.

storyboard.blurb: Turn scenes into frames and plan how each one is covered.

breakdown.blurb: Tag every element in the script, scene by scene.

catalog.blurb: One index of every prop, costume and location the script names.

shot-list.blurb: List the shots for each scene and keep them in order.

schedule.blurb: Arrange scenes into shoot days on a stripboard.

budget.blurb: Estimate costs line by line, from the schedule you already made.

call-sheets.blurb: Build the call sheet for any shoot day from your plan.

cast-crew.blurb: Keep every contact, and who is called on which day.

sides.blurb: Cut the script down to the pages a day needs.

pass._: THE LAUNCH PASS (27 Oct 2026). The free trial is retired for the public; while the launch offer runs, the public pages offer a paid pass instead. {price} and {length} are RUNTIME SLOTS, filled by src/pages/marketing.js from trial_offer().pass through src/lib/pass-offer.js: the server owns the price, the length, the deadline and the cap, and the owner edits them in the console. NEVER type a figure, a date or a count here, in any marketing JSON or in a page (test:marketing fails on one). Everything that names the pass is hidden in the markup ([data-pass-only]) and shown only while the server says the pass is open; the fallback beside it ([data-pass-off]) speaks of the yearly plans, never of a free trial. The countdown is the server's deadline on the server's clock, the same for every visitor.
pass.label: Launch offer
pass.ended: The launch offer has ended. The yearly plans are unchanged.
pass.note: {length} of the whole studio for {price}, once per account. {passTerms}

terms._: OFFER TERMS (27 Oct 2026). Whether a purchase renews is the owner's choice in the console, per product (pass_mode / plan_mode, schema §62), and it can change without a rebuild, so NO static sentence in the marketing JSON may say that a purchase renews or does not (test:marketing). The copy holds tokens instead: {planTerms} and {passTerms} are empty runtime slots that src/pages/marketing.js fills through src/lib/offer-terms.js (the one wording of renewal terms) from trial_offer(); {planRenewNote} is this renewNote, hidden, shown only while plan_mode is 'renew'. An unknown mode fills nothing, so the words around a token must be true either way. Never put a token in a meta description or a title.
terms.renewNote: Your price is locked while you stay, and cancelling takes two taps.

student._live: false: no student promo code exists on the server yet, so the pricing page's students band asks the reader to write to us (contact.html) and names no code. Set true ONLY once the owner has created `code` in the console's promo codes and checked it with quote_order() in both currencies the page can show; the band then names the code and links purchase.html?plan=indie.
